prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a preschool listening picture-card game
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference only; match its flat picture-book rendering, warm pale background, rounded shapes, color polish, and smooth navy outline weight, but do not copy any animal.
Primary request: create one polished wide 3:2 illustration sheet containing exactly six isolated body-part picture-card subjects in this exact left-to-right row order.
Scene/backdrop: one uniform warm pale cream background across the whole sheet, with broad empty gutters separating every cell.
Subject: top row, left to right: one pair of eyes shown together without a face; one pair of ears shown together without a head; one single nose shown alone without a face. Bottom row, left to right: one single mouth shown alone without a face; one single open hand with five fingers, empty and not holding anything; one single bare foot shown alone.
Style/medium: consistent flat picture-book illustration for young children; simple rounded shapes; clean solid color fills; subtle paper-like softness; strong smooth navy outlines of equal visual weight.
Composition/framing: rigid 3-column by 2-row grid on a wide 3:2 canvas; six equal cells; each subject fully contained, isolated, centered, similarly scaled, and surrounded by generous breathing room; clear empty separation and outer margins; no subject crosses a cell boundary.
Lighting/mood: bright, gentle, cheerful, calm, non-frightening; simple educational anatomical icons, not medical.
Constraints: exactly one named body-part subject per cell and exactly six subjects total; preserve the exact ordering; eyes must be two eyes as one pair; ears must be two ears as one pair; all other cells must contain exactly one part; no words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, divider text, logos, signatures, or watermark; no people, faces, heads, bodies, arms, legs, clothing, jewelry, props, or extra objects; the hand must be empty; no cell borders that touch a subject.
Avoid: body-part ambiguity; dismemberment cues; gore; realism; scary anatomy; extra fingers or toes; duplicate parts outside the requested pairs; cropped subjects; adjacent-cell leakage; photorealism; 3D rendering; clutter; artifacts.
